entry.title: PSI is trying to make a business out of AI-driven scientific discovery
entry.summary: PSI used an unreleased Anthropic model to answer a fundamental question about quantum computing that scientists have pursued for nearly two decades.

entry.title: Oura to acquire AI-native primary care startup Counsel Health for $625M
entry.summary: The deal comes a few weeks after Oura postponed its up to $2.2 billion IPO indefinitely, citing “uncertainty in the IPO market.”

entry.title: All 7 Anthropic founders will each cash out about $250M in IPO
entry.summary: Each of the seven co-founders plans to sell exactly the same number of shares in the IPO, which would bring each of them about $250 million in cash at the midpoint of the price range while leaving the group in control of the company.

entry.title: X-energy gets green light to build its first small modular nuclear reactors
entry.summary: X-energy received a construction permit from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission to build four reactors in Texas.

entry.title: Proximal Ventures raises debut fund to back startups bringing AI to drug development
entry.summary: Former SignalFire investor Sahir Raoof raises $27.5 million for new fund targeting AI in pharma.

entry.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
entry.summary: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.

entry.title: OpenAI acquires Odessia, travel startup created by Sonder founder
entry.summary: OpenAI has not yet said what its plans are for the future of travel. But Sonder founder Francis Davidson is a well-known figure in the travel industry.

entry.title: X launches its own clipping feature to spur influencer engagement
entry.summary: X is jumping into clipping, the popular practice of cutting long videos into short, shareable clips that can go viral.

entry.title: Nvidia’s crisis has corporate governance experts reaching for the popcorn
entry.summary: The governance experts we talked to say nobody has seen anything like what's unfolding right now.

entry.title: Plurai wants to help AI agents work better using the same approach that helped get self-driving cars to roads
entry.summary: Like the end-to-end models trained to drive cars, AI agents are probabilistic systems operating in unpredictable environments.

entry.title: Databricks’ new AI agent tells CEO Ali Ghodsi the unvarnished truth
entry.summary: With Databricks at 12,000 employees, AI Ghodsi is the first to admit that he can't know everyone and that they are unlikely to confess the things that go wrong to him. But he doesn't need them to. He uses Databricks' newly revised Genie agent for that.

entry.title: Siri co-founder backs Helix for its voice ID tech
entry.summary: With the rise of AI agents like Instinct and Muse, the industry needs to rethink human identity on the internet and rely on biometric signals like voice, which is where Helix comes in.

entry.title: OpenAI’s quarterly revenue reportedly crosses $10B for the first time
entry.summary: Sales of $10 billion represents an almost 50% jump from revenue of $6.7 billion the company recorded in the second quarter.

entry.title: Is Jensen Huang’s bad behavior more commonplace than it seems?
entry.summary: “There are a lot of senior people in the industry that know this is happening, and are effectively condoning it,” an investment intel consultant said.

entry.title: Congress to call Jensen Huang in to answer for alleged Chinese spy affair
entry.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has until the end of the day Wednesday to answer a call from House Republicans for a closed-door briefing on his affair with alleged Chinese spy.

entry.title: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
entry.summary: Fractile has now become one of the top-funded players in the race for purpose-built AI chips.

entry.title: CoreWeave turns to customer prepayments, shorter contracts to fund AI growth
entry.summary: CoreWeave is increasingly asking customers to pay upfront, borrowing against specific contracts, and even looking to short-term deals that could lead to higher prices, according to the company’s third-quarter earnings.

entry.title: Olaf Sakkers is betting he can beat the emerging-manager squeeze
entry.summary: Entering into the world of venture capital has never been easy, especially as a first-time fund manager. But it's especially daunting right now. Olaf Sakkers has spent the past five years proving that difficult doesn't mean impossible.

entry.title: Meta is losing its longtime head of infrastructure
entry.summary: Santosh Janardhan, who originally joined the company in 2009, will be stepping down from his role.

entry.title: Why the data center you dread might never even be built
